suggestions.reason: Added 7 spec-time decisions (7-13). Most are strengths: 7 (ACTION_SUPERSEDED) closes a real P3 lost-update hole, 11 (failure order) resolves the clash between grill decision 2's 'otherwise 409 WINDOW_CLOSED' and decisions 3-4, and 12 (created_at from Clock) is needed for pinned tests. All are marked _(spec)_ with reasons, so the gate can overrule them. Some is borderline creep: 8 picks 404 for {a}=correction where old_skill picked resolve-to-root, a real user choice that should have been raised as an A/B/C question rather than settled. 10 and 13 are clarifications, not new scope.
There is no `## Acceptance criteria` section, yet deliver-tester.md and deliver-code-reviewer.md read acceptance criteria from the issue. No assertion checks this; only no_subskills noticed it.

suggestions.assertion: spec.md has a `## Decisions` section that carries all six decisions…
suggestions.reason: It does not separate verbatim copies from rewordings that quietly edit a grill decision (here, 'refined by decision 11'). Consider asserting that grill decisions are kept apart from any added ones.

eval_feedback.overall: Strongest spec: complete template, an exact boundary test (15:00 vs 15:00.001), and well-reasoned gap fills labelled as such. Main risks are scope growth (13 decisions for a typo fix) and the missing acceptance-criteria section.
